positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
An important transformation of my career path

Since September 2015 I joined the back-end engineering team as an R&D developer to build up the 'INSIGHT'​ data platform for the Medical Service Business Unit of Baidu company. The 'INSIGHT' is a scalable data visualisation platform that is sourced from varied forms of data infrastructure (e.g. relational databases & Hadoop) and requires high data accuracy as well as consistency, serving as the core data source for every data-driven product upgrade and business strategy of the business unit.

Also responsible for SEO and SEM promotion, including buying traffic, copy editing, launching keywords, monitoring data and adjusting bids.
